STRIKE Array 1.release_notes:
1. Increased the ArtNet universe range to: 0 - 32767, and the sACN universe range to: 1 - 32000.
2. Removed the Starting Address from the Ethernet Settings.
3. Fixed the issue that when connecting to sACN, erroneous message appears: fixture is Leaving group, re-subscribe.
4. Changed the message to “max of 8 pods per drive exceeded” when more than 8 pods are detected.
5. Added message of "max of 7 pods per port exceeded " when one port detects over 7 pods.
6. Fixed DMX addressing bug, UID, and hours reset caused by network upgrade failure.
7. In the router, client list and fixture name will be displayed instead of fixture MAC Address.
